categories.name: Language learning

tools.name: ankieditor
tools.summary: Visually adjust Anki card templates without writing HTML or CSS.
features: Visual font, color, and layout controls
limits: Requires copying templates to and from Anki.
Pricing and account requirements have not been independently confirmed.

tools.name: Yomitan
tools.summary: Look up words while reading and connect vocabulary to Anki.
limits: Browser extension setup and dictionaries are required.
Anki integration needs additional configuration; see the official guide.

tools.name: asbplayer
tools.summary: Use subtitles and video to make multimedia vocabulary flashcards.
features: Anki cards with image and audio
Web app for local video and extension for streaming
limits: Subtitle availability and streaming-site compatibility vary.
Some workflows require an extension and Anki setup.

tools.name: AnkiDecks study tools
tools.summary: Convert study material into Anki decks or export decks to other formats.
limits: This listing covers the free tools collection, not every AnkiDecks product.
Supported formats depend on the individual utility.

tools.name: Neurako Tools
tools.summary: Explore browser-based deck analytics and study utilities.
limits: This listing covers the tools collection, not the separate Neurako app.
The deck enhancer requires your own LLM key; external provider costs may apply.

problems.title: My Anki cards are hard to read
problems.description: Change card typography, colors, and layout without hand-editing every line of a template.

problems.title: I keep interrupting my reading to look up words
problems.description: Find definitions in context and move useful vocabulary into a spaced repetition workflow.

problems.title: I want flashcards from the videos I watch
problems.description: Bring subtitle text, images, and audio into vocabulary cards instead of assembling each part manually.

problems.title: My study material is in the wrong format
problems.description: Move existing spreadsheets or flashcards into or out of Anki with less repetitive copying.

problems.title: I do not understand how my Anki deck is performing
problems.description: Explore review history and deck statistics to understand your study material.

problems.title: I need a simpler way to choose a personal workflow
problems.description: Find a lightweight way to compare recurring tasks and decide which steps to automate first. This is an editorial research prompt, not a user submission.
